title: The plan — derived from S0/S1/S2, adversarially attacked, and corrected in 25 places
status_note: Green means the oracle was satisfied: S3_PLAN.md exists; all 19 items are in DO/BECAUSE/INSTEAD OF/COSTS/FALSIFIED form; every BECAUSE cites a specific S0/S1/S2 finding by id; a separately labelled 'believed, unverified' section carries 11 ASSUMED entries; the pilot is specified to one artist / one task / one abort set concretely enough to propose on Monday; and there are no unlabelled ASSUMED claims. Green does NOT mean the plan is right. Three things a reader must carry: (1) the adversarial pass forced 25 corrections into the draft, two of which were structural defects that would have shipped items cancelling each other — the ORIGINAL draft was wrong in ways only the attack surfaced, and the same is presumably true of this one; (2) 25 of the 30 attack findings were capped out of the independent refutation phase by a declared budget cap — I triaged and adopted them on my OWN re-verification, which is orchestrator verification, not independent refutation, so they are unrefuted rather than confirmed (R124's standing, applied to myself); (3) this leg cites a DIFFERENT copy of S2 than the committed one, inverting R127's default — see for_ruling R-S3-1.

headline.q1: NOTHING qualifies as a first-session moment today, and that is the leg's most important finding. Four verified mechanisms, not a missing feature: every tool runs on the GUI thread behind a phantom attribute; the model is told it is in Houdini 21 in FOUR places; the turn ends green whatever happened; and 21 palette rows type a sentence under a footer reading 'Enter run'.
headline.the_leg_s_own_finding: The product ships TWO recipe libraries with different content and the discoverable one is the poorer one. panel/recipe_book.py::RECIPES = 21 recipes, palette-reachable and prefixed 'Build this network recipe -- '. synapse/routing/recipes/::RecipeRegistry = 62 recipes with 8 cinema-camera sensor datasets, the Lighting Law, 4:1 key:fill math AND natural-language trigger regexes -- reachable by natural language NOWHERE, because TieredRouter is built only in _handle_route_chat, route_chat is one of the 7 handler commands no registered tool reaches, and it is sent only by panel/chat_panel.py which is NOT the shipped panel and is never referenced by it. Confirmed from outside: router_stats returns 'Router not initialized' on BOTH transports.
headline.q2: The TD's veto is answered in 11 rows: security (Gate 0.1+0.3, non-negotiable), the studio-readiness board (scoped by declared posture, not softened), cost (Gate 1.1 -- the item S2 says decided the trial), the suite as an upgrade gate (half-answered; the CI lane is a cost decision, escalated), the per-point-release runbook (partly; the rest is abort condition 3), log noise (Gate 1.6), farm (accepted LIMIT), the second artist's memory (Gate 3.3), $JOB writability (ask), MPA OR-5.0 (a disclosure row, P-2), and scene poisoning (already true and the strongest card in the pack).
headline.q3: One artist, one show, Solaris shot assembly only, one quarter, week-1 kill switch. Converts S2-U21, U6, U14, U3, U10 into observations. Deliberately does NOT convert U1 (the unstoppable render) -- that gets a bench probe on a scratch scene, never a production shot, because spending a real shot to learn it is how the pilot ends at abort condition 1.
headline.the_sentence: SYNAPSE's problem is not that it lacks a moment -- it is that its one proven artist-facing lane sits behind a panel that runs every tool on the GUI thread because of a single phantom attribute, a prompt that thinks it is in Houdini 21 in four places, and two rival recipe libraries of which the discoverable one is the poorer and the richer one's triggers can never fire because the router that matches them is never built on the shipped path.

reframings_that_changed_the_plan: 'Irrefutable' is unachievable and NOVEL is not the goal -- S0-F3 measured the field: largest Houdini-AI repo = 326 stars, both commercial products have ZERO third-party replies across threads with 5,919 views. Novelty is cheap here and nobody is buying it.

'In-process access' is NOT a differentiator. S0-F3: capoomgit/houdini-mcp (273 stars) runs a socket server inside Houdini; healkeiser/fxhoudinimcp (138) uses Houdini's own hwebserver with hdefereval marshalling, verified on 22.0.368, with 179 tools to SYNAPSE's 120. In-process is the field's BASELINE. Every plan item resting on it was deleted.

synapse_inspect_scene does NOT hang -- R125 measured 0.00-0.08s and S1's re-run returned 767 bytes / 10 nodes on BOTH transports. No item fences it. But the non-answering CLASS is live and now owns synapse_scout (NO_RESPONSE at a 180s ceiling on a fresh dedicated server, called first) -- the tool CLAUDE.md rule 15 makes the MANDATORY phantom-API pre-flight. That became Gate 1.5, which the first draft omitted entirely.

The palette is not broken; 9.2% of it is. No row dispatches -- it is a prompt-composer by construction -- so 'prose instead of dispatching' is a contrast that does not exist. 74 of 95 legacy rows carry an imperative prefix. The defect is the 21 command rows with neither a prefix nor a tool name.

findings.summary: hou.webServer.port is ABSENT from the committed 22.0.368 symbol table while its parent hou.webServer is enumerated with 1,312 descendants (1,313 counting the node) -- a TRUE absence, not a coverage artifact. Control run to avoid this repo's own false-phantom trap: hou.undos and hou.hipFile are present with ZERO descendants, so an absence there would prove nothing. Table: 35,903 symbols, blake2b 265b433af49698ab, truncated false. The call sits inside a bare `except Exception: return None`, so `available` is False PERMANENTLY and every tool falls through to the Qt main-thread slot.
findings.producer: direct load of the committed symbol table + sed of the call site, this leg, at b608efc
findings.why_it_bites: This single line is what converts every other timeout and budget in the product from bounded to unbounded: per handlers_render.py:109-113, 'the Qt slot IS the main thread, so run_on_main takes FAST PATH 2 and again discards this timeout'.
findings.safety_check: Repairing it cannot deadlock: try_mcp_tool_call is called from claude_worker.py:254 and ClaudeWorker is a QThread (:49); the function's own docstring reads 'Safe to call from any thread ... NOT safe to call from the main thread (will deadlock with hdefereval)'. Worker-thread-only by construction.
findings.held_under_attack: Graded SOUND by a lens that re-derived the whole table independently and reproduced both controls.

findings.summary: THE PLAN'S OWN TWO GATE-0 ITEMS CANCELLED EACH OTHER, and only the adversarial pass found it. Minting ~/.synapse/auth.key (the security fix) arms THREE server gates and NO in-process client answers any of them: _MCPLocalClient._post sends only Content-Type and Accept, so a keyed /mcp request 401s, _ensure_session raises ConnectionError, try_mcp_tool_call returns None, and execution falls back SILENTLY to the Qt main-thread slot -- precisely the condition the phantom-port repair exists to remove. grep -rn Authorization tests/ is EMPTY: no test pins it.
findings.producer: sed of mcp/server.py:800-820 and tool_executor.py:161-182 + grep across tests/, this leg, at b608efc
findings.consequence_for_the_plan: The two items were merged into ONE commit with client-side credential propagation, an auth pin test whose failure condition is stated, and a POSITIVE path assertion so 'the port resolved' is never mistaken for 'the fast path works'.
findings.note: Found independently by two of four hostile lenses. This finding alone justifies the adversarial pass.

findings.summary: SYNAPSE ships TWO recipe libraries and the discoverable one is the poorer one. Library A: panel/recipe_book.py::RECIPES = 7 categories / 21 recipes, read by the command palette, sent prefixed 'Build this network recipe -- ' -- reachable and actionable. Library B: RecipeRegistry = 62 recipes (pipeline 12, render 11, copernicus 9, lighting 7, fx 6, tops 5, utility 3, geometry 2, materials 2, set_dressing 1, compositing 1, camera 1, environment 1, sim 1) carrying 8 cinema-camera sensor datasets, the Lighting Law and NATURAL-LANGUAGE TRIGGER REGEXES -- unreachable by natural language. TieredRouter is constructed in exactly one place (_handle_route_chat); route_chat is one of the 7 handler commands NO registered tool reaches; and route_chat is sent only by panel/chat_panel.py, which is not the shipped panel and is never referenced by it. Unreachable from all three directions at once.
findings.producer: live RecipeRegistry() instantiation = 62 (and an independent second producer: grep -c 'registry.register(Recipe(' across the recipes package = 62, 7+21+18+11+5); live recipe_book RECIPES = 21; live build_palette_entries() = 95 with Counter({'vex':45,'command':21,'recipe':21,'apex':8}); S1P-registry_xref handler_cmds_with_no_tool = 7 including route_chat; S1P sweeps show router_stats 'Router not initialized' on BOTH transports
findings.why_it_bites: It answers S2-U6 ('whether artists discover the 62-recipe library at all') MECHANICALLY without the user study, and it means the product already ships the 'two competing stories about how a recipe is invoked' that its own reasoning forbids -- unnoticed.

findings.summary: There are FOUR H21 references in the shipped prompt layer, not three, and the obvious guard CANNOT FAIL on its own target. :51 'inside Houdini 21', :189 'in Houdini 21.0.671', :193 'The H21 docs corpus is the authority', :197 'karmaphysicalsky bug (H21)'. `grep -c "Houdini 21"` returns 2 -- so after repairing :51 and :189 the proposed build guard reports clean while :193 still tells the model the H21 corpus is authoritative, which is the exact grounding defect the item exists to close.
findings.producer: grep -n 'Houdini 21|H21|21\.0\.671' + grep -c 'Houdini 21' on system_prompt.py at b608efc
findings.consequence_for_the_plan: The guard was respecified to match `Houdini 21|H21|21\.0\.` AND to carry an explicit allowlist for dated historical notes -- because :197 is a legitimate correct line and a guard that fails forever on a correct line gets disabled, which is how guards die.
findings.law: Law 1 applied to the plan's own check: a check whose stated failure condition does not cover its own target is a decoration.

findings.summary: A currency claim of the shape 'only two PRODUCT files changed, so the prior leg's ledger is current' is unsound when the prior leg anchors outside python/. harness/verify/checks.py changed +88/-6 INSIDE this plan's own commit range (2105453, the Q2 tuple baseline reader), which SUPERSEDES S2#63 / R-S2-5: at HEAD parse_tuple_baseline HARD-REJECTS the flat baseline shape with an error naming the exact defect, check_suite_baseline reads the tuple at the merge-base anchor, and check_ci_covers_shipping_surface already EXISTS requiring a Windows lane plus a vendored-load probe. Two thirds of the drafted Gate 3.2 was already shipped, and the remaining third was WRONG -- the ratchet runs sys.executable, so pointing it at the shipping block would compare a system-python run against an hython baseline.

The plan's currency paragraph was rescoped to python/ with the three disturbed rows named. S2#69 and S2#70 were re-read at HEAD and remain current.

findings.summary: The mandatory phantom-API pre-flight does not answer, and the prompt orders a tool the panel does not carry. S1P-mcp_isolate -- one FRESH MCP server per case, the tool called FIRST, 180s ceiling -- records synapse_scout at elapsed 180.11 with result 'NO_RESPONSE', while every other isolated case returned in 4.02s. Independently: the panel's tool array is 126 entries and synapse_scout is ABSENT from it (synapse_inspect_stage too), while system_prompt.py:186-193 instructs the model to call synapse_scout before authoring non-template LOP nodes.
findings.producer: read of s1_artifacts/mcp_isolate.json + live get_anthropic_tools() length and membership check, this leg
findings.why_it_bites: CLAUDE.md rule 15 makes scout the MANDATORY pre-flight before emitting any unfamiliar hou./pdg./pxr. call -- the front-line defence against this project's self-declared #1 failure class. It does not answer, and the model is told to call something it cannot reach, so it either narrates a scout call it never made or authors from priors: the exact failure scout exists to prevent.
findings.note: The first draft of this plan OMITTED this entirely, having over-generalised from inspect_scene's clean re-run to the whole hang class. Restored as Gate 1.5 by the adversarial pass.

findings.summary: The remedy S2-L1 names for the un-removable freeze exists, is computed, is emitted, and has ZERO consumers -- and repairing the phantom port would DELETE it from the path. estimate_inline_cost has exactly one production call site, inside _preflight, called only from execute_tool, which is the @QtCore.Slot main-thread path. preflight_warning is declared at :300, emitted at :360, and has zero .connect( sites anywhere in python/ or tests/. So the advisory only ever fires on the very path the phantom-port repair removes.
findings.producer: grep -rn estimate_inline_cost / _preflight / preflight_warning across python/ and tests/, this leg
findings.consequence_for_the_plan: The two items ship together, with the estimate relocated into the worker before dispatch so it survives the repair.
findings.held_under_attack: Two independent lenses tried to find a second caller and could not; both graded it SOUND, one calling it 'the sharpest structural argument in the document -- forced by the code, not asserted'.

findings.summary: Two inherited claims were inflated and both were corrected against the tree. (a) The palette does not 'send prose INSTEAD OF dispatching' -- NO row dispatches; it is a prompt-composer by construction (command_selected = Signal(str) # emits a ready-to-send prompt). build_palette_entries() = 95 rows, Counter({'vex':45,'command':21,'recipe':21,'apex':8}); _CATEGORY_PREFIX covers recipe/apex/vex, so 74 of 95 carry an imperative prefix and the 120 tool rows name their tool outright ('Use the `%s` tool.'). The real defect is the 21 command rows (9.2%, not 41.7%) with neither. (b) The foreground guard's refusal is not a dead end: it names a resolution ceiling AND 'or pass force_foreground=true to accept the UI freeze deliberately', and allow_px is per-engine (65,536 for karma_cpu/karma/mantra, 262,144 for karma_xpu) with a per-engine hardware rationale.
findings.producer: live build_palette_entries() + Counter; sed of tool_palette.py and foreground_guard.py; grep force_foreground across the render handlers, this leg
findings.consequence_for_the_plan: A Tier-1 headline was deflated 4.5x, one item was rescoped from 'make rows dispatch' (a redesign of a working component) to 'fix the 21 rows and the footer' with cost 1.5d -> 0.5d, and the render-refusal work was deleted from one item as double-counted.
findings.note: Independently discovered twice: by this leg reading S2's corrected worktree copy, and by two hostile lenses reading the tree.

findings.summary: The install surface is a Gate-0 concern for a two-seat pilot, not a footnote. install.py iterates `for major in [21, 20, 19]` so on an H22-only seat it exits 1 and on the dual-build seat CLAUDE.md names as the target it silently installs into the H21 preference directory; its Windows search root is ~/Documents only while the SIBLING installer documents the OneDrive known-folder redirection at length and handles it -- the two installers disagree and the obvious-named one is the broken one. git ls-files houdini/ returns 3 files and there is NO houdini/config, so the shelf's five SYNAPSE_* icon references resolve to nothing. And S2-L6 re-verified at HEAD: both the vendoring predicate and the ABI-risk warning are sys.platform.startswith('win')-gated, so a Linux studio gets no vendoring AND no notice.

The committed copy still states the palette figure at 41.7%, '40% of the package' (a 4x denominator error -- 10,905 LOC is 39.8% of panel/'s 27,379 and 10.8% of the package's 100,574 excluding _vendor), the escape table without its README attribution, and the foreground-guard quote without force_foreground. findings.why_it_bites: Anyone reading the committed S2 will cite a 4.5x-inflated Tier-1 headline in good faith. It is R127's shape a third time -- a second copy nobody declared existed -- now in the evidence layer rather than a verifier's glob.

adversarial_pass.why_it_matters: S0, S1 and S2 EACH shipped with 'no adversarial pass ran' as a recorded blocker (R124, R-S2-1). This leg ran one against its own draft, which closes that pattern for the first time in the sequence.
adversarial_pass.shape: 4 hostile lenses in parallel (citation integrity / reasoning + falsifiability / independent anchor re-derivation / completeness), then 8 per-finding refutation passes instructed to default to refuted when evidence is thin. Every lens required to return >=2 SOUND entries as a specificity control (R79's discipline). All agents were crucible-class (Read/Grep/Glob/Bash; no Edit/Write in the agent definition).
adversarial_pass.cost: 12 agents, 351 tool calls, 1,717,339 subagent tokens, ~26 min
the_two_that_mattered_most: X-2: Gate 0.1 and Gate 0.3 cancelled each other -- minting the auth key 401s the fast path the other item revives, restoring the GUI-thread fallback SILENTLY while both items report done. Found by two lenses independently.
X-1/X-20: the palette Tier-1 headline was inflated 4.5x and the item built on it aimed at a design property rather than a defect.
refuted_attacks: An attempt to promote the Gate 3.2 finding to SHOWSTOPPER -- it is a bounded line-number-and-adjective repair.
An attempt to show the Q1 candidate was smuggled preference rather than derived -- S1-F7's the_inversion field supports the derivation verbatim.
An attempt to void Gate 1.4 on the ground that its insertion point lacks the needed mechanism -- the mechanism is there (V-S3-20).
adversarial_pass.what_held: 16 SOUND entries. The two most load-bearing: V-S3-1 (a lens re-derived the symbol table independently, reproduced symbol_count, the blake2b prefix, the absence, AND both controls) and the 0.3<->0.4 coupling (two lenses tried to find a second caller of estimate_inline_cost and could not).
adversarial_pass.honest_limit: 25 of the 30 BLOCKER/DEFECT entries were capped out of the independent refutation phase by a declared budget cap the workflow LOGGED rather than hid. I triaged all 25 and adopted the ones above on my own re-verification -- orchestrator verification, not independent refutation. They are UNREFUTED, not confirmed.

for_ruling.item: S2 exists in two divergent copies and this leg cites the UNCOMMITTED one. The committed S2_PREMORTEM.md (83a4820, 1,258 lines) is the pre-adversarial draft; the worktree copy (1,388 lines) carries the corrections R-S2-1 said were outstanding, including a 4.5x-deflated palette headline and a 4x-corrected LOC denominator. R127 rules 'the committed file is the claim'.
for_ruling.why_escalated: Article I -- inverting a standing ruling's default is a value judgement between defensible options, not a fact from the tree. I made the call and verified every adopted correction first-hand against the tree, but ratifying which copy is authoritative is not an agent's to decide.
for_ruling.recommendation: Commit S2's corrected copy (or its diff) so the claim and the evidence coincide, then amend R127's corollary: when a committed artifact is provably an earlier draft than an uncommitted one, the DIVERGENCE is the finding and neither copy is citable until reconciled. Immediate risk if unresolved: anyone reading the committed S2 cites an inflated Tier-1 headline in good faith.

for_ruling.item: Gate 2.1's router question: (a) construct TieredRouter on the shipped panel's path so the 62 recipes' natural-language triggers can fire (~3 days, and it inherits R123's caution that synapse/routing is not live product), or (b) retire the trigger regexes and re-shape the library as tools/prompt content the LLM selects (~1 day). Either way the two recipe libraries -- 21 in panel/recipe_book.py, 62 in synapse/routing/recipes/ -- must be reconciled into one.
for_ruling.why_escalated: Article I -- product direction. (b) is the smaller, more honest move for a pilot; (a) is the larger product bet.
for_ruling.recommendation: Measure before deciding, and it is measurable before any code: does an artist typing 'set up a three-point rig' already get the right result via the LLM electing to call synapse_list_recipes, at acceptable token cost? If yes, (b) with no further argument.

for_ruling.item: R123 ordered synapse/routing and synapse/agent labelled 'not live product' at the top of each module because the routing RSI loop has never run. But RecipeRegistry -- the 62 recipes, the richest artist-facing asset in the product -- lives at synapse/routing/recipes/ and IS reached live by synapse_list_recipes on both transports.
for_ruling.why_escalated: A tree-wide banner applied literally would mislabel live product as dead, which is the inverse of the defect R123 was written to prevent.
for_ruling.recommendation: Make R123's label PER-MODULE, not per-tree, and exclude synapse/routing/recipes/ explicitly.

for_ruling.item: The Windows + hython CI lane. check_ci_covers_shipping_surface already EXISTS at checks.py:1841 and requires a Windows lane plus a vendored-load probe -- so the requirement is asserted in-tree while the lane does not exist. Standing up the lane needs a Houdini licence in CI.
for_ruling.why_escalated: A real cost decision, not an agent's to take (Article I). Now stronger than when R-S2-5 raised it, because a check already asserts the requirement.
for_ruling.recommendation: Either fund the lane, or write down explicitly that the shipping number is measured by hand at release time and by nothing else -- and have check_ci_covers_shipping_surface say which of those two states it is in, so it stops asserting a requirement nobody has accepted.

for_ruling.item: 83a4820 committed harness/notes/forensic/INVENTORY.md -- a v5.4.0-era archived codebase inventory (43 tools, dated 2026-02-15, self-labelled stale, whose 'current truth' line of 115 tools / v5.33.0 is ALSO stale against HEAD's 120 / v5.36.4) -- into the forensic evidence directory beside S0_SCOUT.md and S2_PREMORTEM.md, in a leg sequence whose S1 is titled 'the inventory'.

for_ruling.recommendation: Move it out of harness/notes/forensic/ or rename it to carry its own date and version (e.g. ARCHIVED_INVENTORY_v5.4.0_2026-02-15.md). It is not S1's deliverable and nothing in S3 cites it.

for_ruling.item: S1's deliverable is still not committed anywhere. This leg recovered it from a session transcript -- the SECOND consumer to pay that cost after S2. The recovery pattern is now proven twice (one Write + N Edits replayed, all applying cleanly) and the underlying arrangement still guarantees recurrence: read-only legs are denied git commit by R103, so their products live only in a worktree until someone else commits them.
for_ruling.why_escalated: R-S2-2 already recommended amending R103 and the amendment has not landed; 83a4820 committed the other legs' deliverables but not S1's.
